_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for startup-time-to-release on the `klt sim` harness (issue #468, part of #412). Mechanics: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py; argument: this file.

`pass_requires` lists the five release-criteria signals at every one of the eleven checkpoints -- exactly the set run_pvt_sweep.sh's own `any_missing` check gated on, so a corner that did not converge far enough to print one `meas` line is FAIL here as it was there. The two t=20us `*_early` measurements are informational (the legacy verdict never read them) and are deliberately not required.

`release_time_us` and `checkpoint_verdicts` are derived by sim/harness/enrich_supply_bench_report.py --bench startup_release, so they are only present in the enriched report `--record` consumes; requiring them here is what makes minting an UNenriched report fail loudly instead of silently dropping this bench's headline column.
Claim: Co-simulating bandgap_core + bandgap_amp + bandgap_startup (trim-bearing core at trim_code=128, wired as design/bandgap_top.sch) with vdd ramped 0 -> VDD over 200 us, the earliest time at which the full closed-loop release criteria hold AND keep holding to the end of the 2 ms window can be read off directly, across the 45-point PVT grid. The criteria are the same three sim/closed-loop-startup uses, evaluated at every point of a fixed-time ladder (100 200 300 400 500 600 700 800 900 1000 2000 us) rather than once at a final time: startup released (v(det) <= 0.2*vdd, |i(XMKFB)| <= 50 nA), loop closed (|sns1-sns2| <= 20 mV) and fb not railed. `release_time_us` is the earliest checkpoint with an all-PASS suffix through 2000u, so a corner that transiently satisfies the criteria then regresses is not misreported as released early; `NOT_RELEASED` means no such suffix exists within the window. Resolution is bucketed to the ladder's own 100 us step below 1 ms -- a reported 100 means "already released by the first checkpoint and stayed released", not "released at exactly t=100us". Evidence for comparison against the draft "Startup: self-starting, < 1 ms" spec row (spec/porting-plan.md), not a conformance claim against a ratified spec.
Netlist provenance: design/netlist/bandgap_core.spice (trim-bearing, trim_code=128), design/netlist/bandgap_amp.spice and design/netlist/bandgap_startup.spice, carried verbatim into sim/startup-time-to-release/testbench/startup_time_to_release.body.spice.tmpl (XMSENSE w= read from the live startup netlist). Device-for-device identical to sim/closed-loop-startup's own body, which is what makes the 2000u columns a genuine cross-validation of the two experiments.
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models built by sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (local) / baked into the batch runner image (#277).
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points)
